title: Furientis lands $25M from Benchmark to mass-produce low-cost missile interceptors | TechCrunch
summary: Benchmark is leading a $25 million seed round into Furientis, a startup on a mission to mass-produce interceptor missiles. Marina Temkin is a venture capital and startups reporter at TechCrunch.
